title: Chain-level refinement pentagon for Cech-resolution totals
statement: In the ringed-site refinement setting let gamma be the tuple-formula cochain map, IM and IN injective resolutions, L any nonnegative complex of injectives, lam:u_*IN→L and b:IM→L satisfying the strict coefficient augmentation identity. For any prescribed source and target Augmentations dM,dN there exist global restriction quasi-isomorphisms aL and aP into the Cech-first totals of L and u_*IN, total coefficient maps l and s, tuple restriction total map t, and a degree-zero coefficient augmentation delta. They satisfy dM.beta≫l=delta≫s, gamma≫dN.beta=delta≫t, dM.alpha≫l=Gamma(b)≫aL, aP≫s=Gamma(lam)≫aL, and aP≫t=dN.alpha. The totals are the actual totals of the mapped Cech complex functors; neither lam being monic nor lam being a quasi-isomorphism is needed. Notation: sites and their evaluation functors are [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]; module categories are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; injective resolutions are [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. The chosen Cech complex is [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], its signed first-quadrant total is [def-sp-double-complex-total], and its augmentations and normalization are [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-edge-normalization].

proof.text: Use equality after every projection to prove the omitted-coordinate identities for the tuple maps. The tuple restriction formula in each resolution degree is then a Cech chain map; naturality with respect to the resolution differential gives a map of double complexes and its total t. Coefficient maps b and lam give total maps l and s.

source.place: Tag 01FD, lemma-functoriality-cech, displayed pentagon and three lower squares; sites-cohomology.tex 03AX, 03FC for ringed-site row acyclicity.

proof.text: Construct aL and aP by restriction in Cech degree zero. The rows for L are acyclic because its terms are injective modules; rows for u_*IN identify with the rows of IN on the image covering under u. That family is covering by hcover and its products are preserved by u. The sheaf equalizer gives the zero row cohomology. First-quadrant augmentation therefore makes both restrictions quasi-isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 01FD, lemma-functoriality-cech, displayed pentagon and three lower squares; sites-cohomology.tex 03AX, 03FC for ringed-site row acyclicity.

proof.text: Insert h followed by the target augmentation in resolution degree zero to obtain delta. The target differential kills that augmentation, so this is a chain map. The strict lift identity gives betaM l=delta s. Naturality of the target augmentation and the tuple formula for gamma give gamma betaN=delta t.

source.place: Tag 01FD, lemma-functoriality-cech, displayed pentagon and three lower squares; sites-cohomology.tex 03AX, 03FC for ringed-site row acyclicity.

proof.text: Coefficient naturality gives alphaM l=Gamma(b) aL and aP s=Gamma(lam) aL. Finally restriction through u(U_rj) then through V_j is direct restriction to V_j, proving aP t=alphaN. Check on each total coprojection: all maps preserve Cech degree, so the total signs agree.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSite_cech_refinement_pentagon
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D]
    (J : Precoverage C) (K : Precoverage D)
    [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition] [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    [K.HasIsos] [K.IsStableUnderComposition] [K.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [K.HasPullbacks]
    (u : C ⥤ D) [PreservesFiniteLimits u]
    (hcover : ∀ (Y : C) (S : Presieve Y), S ∈ J Y → S.map u ∈ K (u.obj Y))
    [u.IsContinuous J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback u (Type u) J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (sheafPullback u (Type u) J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck)]
    (R : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck RingCat.{u}) (R' : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck RingCat.{u})
    (ρ : R ⟶ (u.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u}
      J.toGrothendieck K.toGrothendieck).obj R')
    [EnoughInjectives (ringedSiteModules.{u} R)]
    [EnoughInjectives (ringedSiteModules.{u} R')]
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} R) (N : ringedSiteModules.{u} R')
    (h : M ⟶ (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).obj N)
    {X : C} (hX : IsTerminal X) (huX : IsTerminal (u.obj X))
    {I₀ I₁ : Type u} [Finite I₀] [Finite I₁]
    (U : I₀ → C) (v : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (V : I₁ → D) (w : ∀ j, V j ⟶ u.obj X)
    (hU : Presieve.ofArrows U v ∈ J X)
    (hV : Presieve.ofArrows V w ∈ K (u.obj X))
    (S : SiteCechComplex U v) (T : SiteCechComplex V w)
    (r : I₁ → I₀) (a : ∀ j, V j ⟶ u.obj (U (r j)))
    (aTuple : ∀ (p : ℕ) (j : Fin (p + 1) → I₁),
      T.W p j ⟶ u.obj (S.W p (r ∘ j)))
    (haTuple : ∀ (p : ℕ) (j : Fin (p + 1) → I₁) (k : Fin (p + 1)),
      aTuple p j ≫ u.map (S.pr p (r ∘ j) k) = T.pr p j k ≫ a (j k))
    (γ : S.complex M.val.presheaf ⟶ T.complex N.val.presheaf)
    (hγ : ∀ (p : ℕ) (s : S.cochains M.val.presheaf p) (j : Fin (p + 1) → I₁),
      (γ.f p s) j = N.val.presheaf.map (aTuple p j).op
        ((h.val.app (op (S.W p (r ∘ j)))) (s (r ∘ j))))
    (IM : InjectiveResolution M) (IN : InjectiveResolution N)
    (L : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u} R) ℕ)
    (lam : ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
      IN.cocomplex ⟶ L) (b : IM.cocomplex ⟶ L)
    (hL : ∀ n : ℕ, Injective (L.X n))
    (hb : IM.ι.f 0 ≫ b.f 0 = h ≫
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).map (IN.ι.f 0) ≫ lam.f 0)
    (dM : S.Augmentations (SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj) IM)
    (dN : T.Augmentations (SheafOfModules.forget R' ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R'.obj) IN) :
    let P := SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj
    let F := P ⋙ (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op X)
    let Q := (HomologicalComplex₂.flip
      (((P ⋙ S.complexFunctor).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj L)).total (.up ℕ)
    let B := (HomologicalComplex₂.flip
      (((P ⋙ S.complexFunctor).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        (((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
          IN.cocomplex))).total (.up ℕ)
    ∃ (aL : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj L ⟶ Q)
      (aP : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        (((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
          IN.cocomplex) ⟶ B)
      (l : (S.resolutionDoubleComplex P IM).total (.up ℕ) ⟶ Q)
      (s : B ⟶ Q)
      (t : B ⟶ (T.resolutionDoubleComplex (SheafOfModules.forget R' ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R'.obj) IN).total (.up ℕ))
      (delta : S.complex M.val.presheaf ⟶ B),
      QuasiIso aL ∧ QuasiIso aP ∧
      dM.beta ≫ l = delta ≫ s ∧
      γ ≫ dN.beta = delta ≫ t ∧
      dM.alpha ≫ l = (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map b ≫ aL ∧
      aP ≫ s = (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map lam ≫ aL ∧
      aP ≫ t = dN.alpha
